what_this_is_en: Read by claude-opus-5 from the enriched source alone, with no sight of any extraction output. Every substance named on every line, read independently and asked only that: not roles, not quantities, not whether it matters. `specific` names one substance you could draw or buy; `generic` refers to a substance without naming one, and is counted apart because `a solvent` is sometimes an anaphor and sometimes the finding. Each distinct printed form is filed once per line: mesotrione three times on one line is one entry, but `Mesotrione` and `mesotrione` on the same line are two, because this document's spelling is inconsistent and the inconsistency is data. On an `[IMAGE_EXTRACT]` line the substances are what the drawing prints, so the span is the SMILES the vision pass read off each structure, plus any substance named in the condition text.

drawn_only_reagents_not_carried_en._why: The first pass of this reading quoted reagent labels out of the IMAGE_EXTRACT JSON on drawing lines. That JSON is machine-readable structure, not text: the English rendering of a drawing line is 'Drawn on the page: N structures' plus the formula and SMILES of each structure drawn, and it carries no condition labels at all. So those spans named a line they were not on and verify.py stopped the run, correctly. They are removed above. Removing them is recorded here rather than done silently, because two of them are named nowhere else in this document and the coverage sweep can no longer see them.

(CH3CH2 )3N.the_substance_is_still_recorded: yes, as 'triethylamine' in the prose at lines 245, 246, 329 and 330. Only this formula spelling is lost.

Sodium acetate.the_substance_is_still_recorded: NO. Sodium acetate is named on the drawing at line 75 and nowhere else in this document. Line 70 prose says 'acetic acid and acetate ion', which is not the same claim. The coverage sweep can no longer see this one.

V2O5.the_substance_is_still_recorded: yes, as 'vanadium pentoxide' in the prose at lines 77, 78, 81, 82, 88 and 89. Only the formula spelling is lost.

O2.the_substance_is_still_recorded: NO. Molecular oxygen appears only as the drawn condition 'Nitric acid/O2' at line 83. The prose at line 81 recites sulphuric acid, nitric acid and vanadium pentoxide, and no oxygen. The coverage sweep can no longer see this one.

drawn_only_reagents_not_carried_en.both_uncarried_substances_are_prior_art_: Sodium acetate and O2 are conditions on background-art schemes, lines 75 and 83, which recite US 5,591,890 and CN 105669504 A. They are not this patent's chemistry, so the loss does not touch the invention's own route. Recorded because a loss that happens to be harmless is still a loss.
